evidence: Users in VLAN 30 on SW1 cannot reach users in VLAN 30 on SW2.
SW1 show interfaces trunk output shows Gi0/1 trunking with allowed VLANs 10,20, and allowed and active VLANs 10,20.
PC5 and PC6 access ports are in VLAN 30.
root_cause: VLAN 30 is missing from the allowed VLAN list on the inter-switch trunk Gi0/1.
verification: Run show interfaces trunk on SW1 and confirm VLAN 30 is included in the allowed and active VLANs list.
Manually test connectivity from PC5 to PC6 to confirm communication in VLAN 30.
fix_steps: Verify the trunk allowed VLAN list on SW1 using show interfaces trunk.
Access global configuration mode on SW1 and the trunk interface Gi0/1.
Add VLAN 30 to the allowed trunk VLAN list using the command switchport trunk allowed vlan add 30.
Verify that VLAN 30 now appears in the allowed and active VLANs list on the trunk.
Test connectivity between PC5 and PC6 in VLAN 30.

rule_checker_findings.evidence: Trunk port allowed VLAN list omits intended VLAN 20.
rule_checker_findings.recommended_action: Add VLAN 20 to switchport trunk allowed vlan list.
